t: Signature AirSim: What AirSim Is: The Drone's Simulator
title: Signature AirSim: What AirSim Is: The Drone's Simulator
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigSky bench, Manon's original vehicle-AI simulation design. It mirrors the API-driven architecture but every scenario carries a fidelity manifest — which physics are modeled to what accuracy — so trained policies always know the limits of their education.

t: Signature AirSim: APIs: Flying with Code
title: Signature AirSim: APIs: Flying with Code
description: The bench's API is the flight desk: same command/state vocabulary, with every call logged to the scenario record. The Signature design makes the desk's determinism explicit — the seed and step mode are part of every experiment record, so results replay exactly.

t: Signature AirSim: Physics: The Custom Flight Model
title: Signature AirSim: Physics: The Custom Flight Model
description: The bench's physics is the wind tunnel: drone-specialized dynamics with parameters carrying provenance tags. The Signature design requires measured motor curves for control development — guessed thrust curves are flagged in the manifest, and policies trained on flagged physics carry the warning.

title: Signature AirSim: Sensors: Cameras, Lidar, Depth

t: Signature AirSim: HIL: Real Autopilot, Simulated World
title: Signature AirSim: HIL: Real Autopilot, Simulated World
description: The bench's HIL is the iron sky: real autopilot, simulated world, scripted faults. The Signature design requires the iron-sky suite green before first flight — GPS denied, motor degraded, link dropped — with the autopilot's real responses recorded.

t: Signature AirSim: AI Training: Learning to Fly
title: Signature AirSim: AI Training: Learning to Fly
description: The bench's training doctrine is the graduated sky: sim episodes, caged flight, open flight — gates between each. The Signature design requires the gap analysis at each gate: what the sim did not model, and whether it mattered.
